name: Cubing for a Cure Dayton 2020
information:
# THIS COMPETITION HAS UNFORTUNATELY BEEN CANCELLED DUE TO A WATER PIPE BREAKING AT THE VENUE

There is a registration fee of $16. All proceeds from the competition will go to the Leukemia & Lymphoma Society!

There is a competitor limit of 100.

**Pyraminx** is the main event of this competition.
